developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_pitr_backups_enabled_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Automated Point-in-Time Table Backups in Multi-Region Locations (Tier-7 • Profile U)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.auto_backup
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure auto_backup for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI NoSQL Database"]
      requirement["Enable Automated Point-in-Time Table Backups in Multi-Region Locations"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0236"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-nosql", label: "OCI NoSQL Database", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_vault_cmk_encryption_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce On-Demand Table Encryption with OCI Vault KMS Keys (Tier-8 • Profile V)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.table_limits
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure table_limits.kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_compartment_policy_isolation_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IAM Compartment-Level Read and Write Policy Isolation (Tier-8 • Profile W)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_identity_policy"
  not r.change.after.statements
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure statements for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_pitr_backups_enabled_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Automated Point-in-Time Table Backups in Multi-Region Locations (Tier-8 • Profile X)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.auto_backup
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure auto_backup for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_vault_cmk_encryption_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce On-Demand Table Encryption with OCI Vault KMS Keys (Tier-9 • Profile Y)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.table_limits
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure table_limits.kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_compartment_policy_isolation_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IAM Compartment-Level Read and Write Policy Isolation (Tier-9 • Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_identity_policy"
  not r.change.after.statements
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure statements for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI NoSQL Database"]
      requirement["Enforce IAM Compartment-Level Read and Write Policy Isolation"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0241"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-nosql", label: "OCI NoSQL Database", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_pitr_backups_enabled_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Automated Point-in-Time Table Backups in Multi-Region Locations (Tier-9 • Profile A)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.auto_backup
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure auto_backup for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_vault_cmk_encryption_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce On-Demand Table Encryption with OCI Vault KMS Keys (Tier-10 • Profile B)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.table_limits
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure table_limits.kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_compartment_policy_isolation_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IAM Compartment-Level Read and Write Policy Isolation (Tier-10 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_identity_policy"
  not r.change.after.statements
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure statements for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI NoSQL Database"]
      requirement["Enforce IAM Compartment-Level Read and Write Policy Isolation"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0244"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-nosql", label: "OCI NoSQL Database", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_pitr_backups_enabled_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Automated Point-in-Time Table Backups in Multi-Region Locations (Tier-10 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.auto_backup
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure auto_backup for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_vault_cmk_encryption_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce On-Demand Table Encryption with OCI Vault KMS Keys (Tier-11 • Profile E)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.table_limits
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure table_limits.kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_compartment_policy_isolation_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IAM Compartment-Level Read and Write Policy Isolation (Tier-11 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_identity_policy"
  not r.change.after.statements
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure statements for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI NoSQL Database"]
      requirement["Enforce IAM Compartment-Level Read and Write Policy Isolation"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0247"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-nosql", label: "OCI NoSQL Database", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_pitr_backups_enabled_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Automated Point-in-Time Table Backups in Multi-Region Locations (Tier-11 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.auto_backup
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure auto_backup for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_vault_cmk_encryption_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce On-Demand Table Encryption with OCI Vault KMS Keys (Tier-12 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.table_limits
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure table_limits.kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    end

steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_compartment_policy_isolation_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IAM Compartment-Level Read and Write Policy Isolation (Tier-12 • Profile I)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_identity_policy"
  not r.change.after.statements
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure statements for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_pitr_backups_enabled_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Automated Point-in-Time Table Backups in Multi-Region Locations (Tier-12 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.auto_backup
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure auto_backup for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_vault_cmk_encryption_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce On-Demand Table Encryption with OCI Vault KMS Keys (Tier-13 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.table_limits
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure table_limits.kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI NoSQL Database"]
      requirement["Enforce On-Demand Table Encryption with OCI Vault KMS Keys"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0252"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-nosql", label: "OCI NoSQL Database", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }

      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_compartment_policy_isolation_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IAM Compartment-Level Read and Write Policy Isolation (Tier-13 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_identity_policy"
  not r.change.after.statements
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure statements for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_pitr_backups_enabled_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Automated Point-in-Time Table Backups in Multi-Region Locations (Tier-13 • Profile M)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.auto_backup
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure auto_backup for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_vault_cmk_encryption_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce On-Demand Table Encryption with OCI Vault KMS Keys (Tier-14 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.table_limits
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure table_limits.kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI NoSQL Database"]
      requirement["Enforce On-Demand Table Encryption with OCI Vault KMS Keys"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0255"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-nosql", label: "OCI NoSQL Database", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_compartment_policy_isolation_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IAM Compartment-Level Read and Write Policy Isolation (Tier-14 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_identity_policy"
  not r.change.after.statements
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure statements for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_pitr_backups_enabled_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Automated Point-in-Time Table Backups in Multi-Region Locations (Tier-14 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.auto_backup
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure auto_backup for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_nosql.oci_nosql_nosql_vault_cmk_encryption_t15

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce On-Demand Table Encryption with OCI Vault KMS Keys (Tier-15 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_nosql_table"
  not r.change.after.table_limits
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure table_limits.kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI NoSQL Database"]
      requirement["Enforce On-Demand Table Encryption with OCI Vault KMS Keys"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0258"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-nosql", label: "OCI NoSQL Database", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_cluster_endpoint_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Clusters with Private Kubernetes API Endpoints
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.endpoint_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure endpoint_config.is_public_ip_enabled for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    end

      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0259"]
      requirement --> check

    end

      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }

    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]

      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }

      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_worker_nodes_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_node_pool"
  not r.change.after.node_config_details
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure node_config_details.placement_configs for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0260"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_kms_secrets_encryption_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubernetes Native KMS Encryption for Secrets at Rest
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_pod_security_standards_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Pod Security Standards Restricted Profile on All OKE Namespaces
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.options
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure options.admission_controller_options.is_pod_security_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Enforce Pod Security Standards Restricted Profile on All OKE Namespaces"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0262"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_cluster_endpoint_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Clusters with Private Kubernetes API Endpoints (Tier-2 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.endpoint_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure endpoint_config.is_public_ip_enabled for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]

      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end
