developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_worker_nodes_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4 (Tier-2 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_node_pool"
  not r.change.after.node_config_details
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure node_config_details.placement_configs for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_kms_secrets_encryption_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubernetes Native KMS Encryption for Secrets at Rest (Tier-2 • Profile G)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_pod_security_standards_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Pod Security Standards Restricted Profile on All OKE Namespaces (Tier-2 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.options
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure options.admission_controller_options.is_pod_security_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_cluster_endpoint_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Clusters with Private Kubernetes API Endpoints (Tier-3 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.endpoint_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure endpoint_config.is_public_ip_enabled for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Deploy OKE Clusters with Private Kubernetes API Endpoints"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0267"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_worker_nodes_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4 (Tier-3 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_node_pool"
  not r.change.after.node_config_details
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure node_config_details.placement_configs for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]

      requirement --> check

      check -->|Yes| review

    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }

      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify

      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_kms_secrets_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubernetes Native KMS Encryption for Secrets at Rest (Tier-3 • Profile K)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Enforce Kubernetes Native KMS Encryption for Secrets at Rest"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0269"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_pod_security_standards_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Pod Security Standards Restricted Profile on All OKE Namespaces (Tier-3 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.options
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure options.admission_controller_options.is_pod_security_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_cluster_endpoint_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Clusters with Private Kubernetes API Endpoints (Tier-4 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.endpoint_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure endpoint_config.is_public_ip_enabled for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Deploy OKE Clusters with Private Kubernetes API Endpoints"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0271"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_worker_nodes_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4 (Tier-4 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_node_pool"
  not r.change.after.node_config_details
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure node_config_details.placement_configs for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_kms_secrets_encryption_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubernetes Native KMS Encryption for Secrets at Rest (Tier-4 • Profile O)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Enforce Kubernetes Native KMS Encryption for Secrets at Rest"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0273"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_pod_security_standards_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Pod Security Standards Restricted Profile on All OKE Namespaces (Tier-4 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.options
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure options.admission_controller_options.is_pod_security_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_cluster_endpoint_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Clusters with Private Kubernetes API Endpoints (Tier-5 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.endpoint_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure endpoint_config.is_public_ip_enabled for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Deploy OKE Clusters with Private Kubernetes API Endpoints"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0275"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_worker_nodes_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4 (Tier-5 • Profile R)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_node_pool"
  not r.change.after.node_config_details
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure node_config_details.placement_configs for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_kms_secrets_encryption_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubernetes Native KMS Encryption for Secrets at Rest (Tier-5 • Profile S)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_pod_security_standards_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Pod Security Standards Restricted Profile on All OKE Namespaces (Tier-5 • Profile T)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.options
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure options.admission_controller_options.is_pod_security_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

# Rule: Deploy OKE Clusters with Private Kubernetes API Endpoints (Tier-6 • Profile U)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.endpoint_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure endpoint_config.is_public_ip_enabled for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_worker_nodes_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4 (Tier-6 • Profile V)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_node_pool"
  not r.change.after.node_config_details
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure node_config_details.placement_configs for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0280"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_kms_secrets_encryption_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubernetes Native KMS Encryption for Secrets at Rest (Tier-6 • Profile W)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_pod_security_standards_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Pod Security Standards Restricted Profile on All OKE Namespaces (Tier-6 • Profile X)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.options
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure options.admission_controller_options.is_pod_security_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Enforce Pod Security Standards Restricted Profile on All OKE Namespaces"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0282"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_cluster_endpoint_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Clusters with Private Kubernetes API Endpoints (Tier-7 • Profile Y)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.endpoint_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure endpoint_config.is_public_ip_enabled for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end

      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}

      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0283"]
      requirement --> check

      check -->|Yes| review

    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }

      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_worker_nodes_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4 (Tier-7 • Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_node_pool"
  not r.change.after.node_config_details
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure node_config_details.placement_configs for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0284"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_kms_secrets_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubernetes Native KMS Encryption for Secrets at Rest (Tier-7 • Profile A)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_pod_security_standards_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Pod Security Standards Restricted Profile on All OKE Namespaces (Tier-7 • Profile B)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.options
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure options.admission_controller_options.is_pod_security_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Enforce Pod Security Standards Restricted Profile on All OKE Namespaces"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0286"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_cluster_endpoint_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Clusters with Private Kubernetes API Endpoints (Tier-8 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.endpoint_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure endpoint_config.is_public_ip_enabled for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_private_worker_nodes_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4 (Tier-8 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_node_pool"
  not r.change.after.node_config_details
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure node_config_details.placement_configs for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Oracle Container Engine for K8s"]
      requirement["Deploy OKE Worker Nodes in Private Subnets with No Public IPv4"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0288"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-oke", label: "Oracle Container Engine for K8s", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_oke.oci_oke_oke_kms_secrets_encryption_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubernetes Native KMS Encryption for Secrets at Rest (Tier-8 • Profile E)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
