developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_private_subnet_execution_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Subnet Placement for OCI Functions Execution (Tier-5 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.subnet_ids
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure subnet_ids for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_image_signature_verification_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Function Image Signature Verification and Signed Digest Pull (Tier-5 • Profile R)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.image_policy_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure image_policy_config.is_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    end

      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_function"
  not r.change.after.config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure config for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_api_gw_jwt_mtls_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce mTLS and JWT Token Validation on OCI API Gateway Deployments (Tier-5 • Profile T)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_apigateway_deployment"
  not r.change.after.specification
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure specification.request_policies.authentication.type for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_private_subnet_execution_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Subnet Placement for OCI Functions Execution (Tier-6 • Profile U)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.subnet_ids
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure subnet_ids for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Functions & API Gateway"]

      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0322"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end

      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-functions", label: "OCI Functions & API Gateway", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end

      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]

      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_image_signature_verification_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Function Image Signature Verification and Signed Digest Pull (Tier-6 • Profile V)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.image_policy_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure image_policy_config.is_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_vault_secrets_reference_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Store Function Configuration Secrets in OCI Vault with Secret OCID References (Tier-6 • Profile W)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_function"
  not r.change.after.config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure config for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_api_gw_jwt_mtls_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce mTLS and JWT Token Validation on OCI API Gateway Deployments (Tier-6 • Profile X)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_apigateway_deployment"
  not r.change.after.specification
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure specification.request_policies.authentication.type for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Functions & API Gateway"]
      requirement["Enforce mTLS and JWT Token Validation on OCI API Gateway Deployments"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0325"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-functions", label: "OCI Functions & API Gateway", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_private_subnet_execution_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Subnet Placement for OCI Functions Execution (Tier-7 • Profile Y)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.subnet_ids
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure subnet_ids for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_image_signature_verification_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Function Image Signature Verification and Signed Digest Pull (Tier-7 • Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.image_policy_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure image_policy_config.is_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_vault_secrets_reference_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Store Function Configuration Secrets in OCI Vault with Secret OCID References (Tier-7 • Profile A)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_function"
  not r.change.after.config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure config for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.

oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table

checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_api_gw_jwt_mtls_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce mTLS and JWT Token Validation on OCI API Gateway Deployments (Tier-7 • Profile B)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_apigateway_deployment"
  not r.change.after.specification
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure specification.request_policies.authentication.type for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_private_subnet_execution_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Subnet Placement for OCI Functions Execution (Tier-8 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.subnet_ids
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure subnet_ids for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_image_signature_verification_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Function Image Signature Verification and Signed Digest Pull (Tier-8 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.image_policy_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure image_policy_config.is_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_function"
  not r.change.after.config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure config for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_api_gw_jwt_mtls_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce mTLS and JWT Token Validation on OCI API Gateway Deployments (Tier-8 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_apigateway_deployment"
  not r.change.after.specification
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure specification.request_policies.authentication.type for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_private_subnet_execution_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Subnet Placement for OCI Functions Execution (Tier-9 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.subnet_ids
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure subnet_ids for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Functions & API Gateway"]

      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0334"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end

      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-functions", label: "OCI Functions & API Gateway", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }

      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_image_signature_verification_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Function Image Signature Verification and Signed Digest Pull (Tier-9 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.image_policy_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure image_policy_config.is_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_vault_secrets_reference_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Store Function Configuration Secrets in OCI Vault with Secret OCID References (Tier-9 • Profile I)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_function"
  not r.change.after.config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure config for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_api_gw_jwt_mtls_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce mTLS and JWT Token Validation on OCI API Gateway Deployments (Tier-9 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_apigateway_deployment"
  not r.change.after.specification
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure specification.request_policies.authentication.type for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Functions & API Gateway"]
      requirement["Enforce mTLS and JWT Token Validation on OCI API Gateway Deployments"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0337"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-functions", label: "OCI Functions & API Gateway", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_private_subnet_execution_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Subnet Placement for OCI Functions Execution (Tier-10 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.subnet_ids
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure subnet_ids for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_image_signature_verification_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Function Image Signature Verification and Signed Digest Pull (Tier-10 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.image_policy_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure image_policy_config.is_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_vault_secrets_reference_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Store Function Configuration Secrets in OCI Vault with Secret OCID References (Tier-10 • Profile M)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_function"
  not r.change.after.config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure config for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    end

      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.

oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"

checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_api_gw_jwt_mtls_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce mTLS and JWT Token Validation on OCI API Gateway Deployments (Tier-10 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_apigateway_deployment"
  not r.change.after.specification
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure specification.request_policies.authentication.type for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_private_subnet_execution_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Subnet Placement for OCI Functions Execution (Tier-11 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.subnet_ids
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure subnet_ids for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_functions.oci_functions_functions_image_signature_verification_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Function Image Signature Verification and Signed Digest Pull (Tier-11 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_functions_application"
  not r.change.after.image_policy_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure image_policy_config.is_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      verify --> outcome

      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

deny[msg] {

  not r.change.after.config

developer_guide.name: Synchronous API request handling
developer_guide.contract: HTTP method, route, request schema, auth context and response status
dependencies: A deployed handler or container and an HTTP route
An invocation identity and downstream SDK permissions
steps: Implement schema validation and authorization in the handler.
Configure the HTTP integration and runtime identity.
Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts and response limits.
tests: Send valid and invalid requests and assert status and response schema.
Exercise authorization failure, duplicate submission and downstream timeout.
failures: 502: inspect integration response format and handler logs.
Timeout: compare gateway, runtime and downstream deadlines.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_waf.oci_waf_waf_attached_to_load_balancer_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Web Application Firewall (WAF) on Public Load Balancer Ingress
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_waf_web_app_firewall"
  not r.change.after.backend_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure backend_type for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Edge request routing and origin access
developer_guide.contract: Public hostname, certificate, cache key, origin host and auth policy
dependencies: A reachable application or object origin
A public certificate and explicit DNS records
Configured origin access and any attached WAF or identity policy
steps: Deploy and test the origin independently.
Configure edge routing, origin authentication and cache behavior.
Attach the intended protection and verify allowed and blocked requests.
tests: Test cache hits, cache misses and authenticated routes.
Verify disallowed requests are rejected and the origin access policy holds.
failures: 403: distinguish edge policy rejection from origin permission failure.
Stale content: inspect cache keys, TTL and invalidation behavior.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_waf.oci_waf_waf_owasp_top_10_rules_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Protection Rules for OWASP Top 10 Threats and SQL Injection
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_waf_web_app_firewall_policy"
  not r.change.after.request_protection
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure request_protection.rules.action_name for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Edge request routing and origin access
developer_guide.contract: Public hostname, certificate, cache key, origin host and auth policy
dependencies: A reachable application or object origin
A public certificate and explicit DNS records
Configured origin access and any attached WAF or identity policy
steps: Deploy and test the origin independently.
Configure edge routing, origin authentication and cache behavior.
Attach the intended protection and verify allowed and blocked requests.
tests: Test cache hits, cache misses and authenticated routes.
Verify disallowed requests are rejected and the origin access policy holds.
failures: 403: distinguish edge policy rejection from origin permission failure.
Stale content: inspect cache keys, TTL and invalidation behavior.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_waf.oci_waf_waf_bot_detection_rate_limit_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Rate Limiting and Challenge-Based Bot Detection on WAF Policy
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_waf_web_app_firewall_policy"
  not r.change.after.request_rate_limiting
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure request_rate_limiting.rules for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI WAF"]
      requirement["Enable Rate Limiting and Challenge-Based Bot Detection on WAF Policy"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0347"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-waf", label: "OCI WAF", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Edge request routing and origin access
developer_guide.contract: Public hostname, certificate, cache key, origin host and auth policy
dependencies: A reachable application or object origin
A public certificate and explicit DNS records
Configured origin access and any attached WAF or identity policy
steps: Deploy and test the origin independently.
Configure edge routing, origin authentication and cache behavior.
Attach the intended protection and verify allowed and blocked requests.
tests: Test cache hits, cache misses and authenticated routes.
Verify disallowed requests are rejected and the origin access policy holds.
failures: 403: distinguish edge policy rejection from origin permission failure.
Stale content: inspect cache keys, TTL and invalidation behavior.

oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table

checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_waf.oci_waf_waf_logging_analytics_stream_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Log All WAF Block Actions to Centralized Encrypted Logging Analytics
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_logging_log"
  not r.change.after.log_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure log_type for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Edge request routing and origin access
developer_guide.contract: Public hostname, certificate, cache key, origin host and auth policy
dependencies: A reachable application or object origin
A public certificate and explicit DNS records
Configured origin access and any attached WAF or identity policy
steps: Deploy and test the origin independently.
Configure edge routing, origin authentication and cache behavior.
Attach the intended protection and verify allowed and blocked requests.
tests: Test cache hits, cache misses and authenticated routes.
Verify disallowed requests are rejected and the origin access policy holds.
failures: 403: distinguish edge policy rejection from origin permission failure.
Stale content: inspect cache keys, TTL and invalidation behavior.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_waf.oci_waf_waf_attached_to_load_balancer_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Web Application Firewall (WAF) on Public Load Balancer Ingress (Tier-2 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_waf_web_app_firewall"
  not r.change.after.backend_type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure backend_type for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
