opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_private_endpoint_enforced_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools (Tier-3 • Profile G)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.private_endpoint_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure private_endpoint_settings.subnet_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Streaming"]
      requirement["Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0781"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-streaming", label: "OCI Streaming", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.

: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"

checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_vault_cmk_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Vault Customer-Managed Key (KMS) Encryption on Stream Pools (Tier-3 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_kafka_sasl_tls_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce SASL/SCRAM and TLS Transport for Kafka Client Connectivity (Tier-3 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kafka_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kafka_settings.bootstrap_servers for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_private_endpoint_enforced_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools (Tier-4 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.private_endpoint_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure private_endpoint_settings.subnet_id for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_vault_cmk_encryption_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Vault Customer-Managed Key (KMS) Encryption on Stream Pools (Tier-4 • Profile K)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_kafka_sasl_tls_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce SASL/SCRAM and TLS Transport for Kafka Client Connectivity (Tier-4 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kafka_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kafka_settings.bootstrap_servers for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_private_endpoint_enforced_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools (Tier-5 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.private_endpoint_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure private_endpoint_settings.subnet_id for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Streaming"]
      requirement["Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0787"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-streaming", label: "OCI Streaming", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.

: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table

checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_vault_cmk_encryption_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Vault Customer-Managed Key (KMS) Encryption on Stream Pools (Tier-5 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_kafka_sasl_tls_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce SASL/SCRAM and TLS Transport for Kafka Client Connectivity (Tier-5 • Profile O)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kafka_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kafka_settings.bootstrap_servers for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Streaming"]
      requirement["Enforce SASL/SCRAM and TLS Transport for Kafka Client Connectivity"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0789"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-streaming", label: "OCI Streaming", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_private_endpoint_enforced_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools (Tier-6 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.private_endpoint_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure private_endpoint_settings.subnet_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_vault_cmk_encryption_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Vault Customer-Managed Key (KMS) Encryption on Stream Pools (Tier-6 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    end

      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_kafka_sasl_tls_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce SASL/SCRAM and TLS Transport for Kafka Client Connectivity (Tier-6 • Profile R)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kafka_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kafka_settings.bootstrap_servers for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_private_endpoint_enforced_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools (Tier-7 • Profile S)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.private_endpoint_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure private_endpoint_settings.subnet_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Streaming"]
      requirement["Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0793"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-streaming", label: "OCI Streaming", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.

: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"

checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_vault_cmk_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Vault Customer-Managed Key (KMS) Encryption on Stream Pools (Tier-7 • Profile T)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_kafka_sasl_tls_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce SASL/SCRAM and TLS Transport for Kafka Client Connectivity (Tier-7 • Profile U)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kafka_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kafka_settings.bootstrap_servers for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_private_endpoint_enforced_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools (Tier-8 • Profile V)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.private_endpoint_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure private_endpoint_settings.subnet_id for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_vault_cmk_encryption_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Vault Customer-Managed Key (KMS) Encryption on Stream Pools (Tier-8 • Profile W)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_kafka_sasl_tls_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce SASL/SCRAM and TLS Transport for Kafka Client Connectivity (Tier-8 • Profile X)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kafka_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kafka_settings.bootstrap_servers for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_private_endpoint_enforced_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools (Tier-9 • Profile Y)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.private_endpoint_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure private_endpoint_settings.subnet_id for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Streaming"]
      requirement["Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0799"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-streaming", label: "OCI Streaming", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.

: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"

checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_vault_cmk_encryption_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Vault Customer-Managed Key (KMS) Encryption on Stream Pools (Tier-9 • Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_kafka_sasl_tls_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce SASL/SCRAM and TLS Transport for Kafka Client Connectivity (Tier-9 • Profile A)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kafka_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kafka_settings.bootstrap_servers for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Streaming"]
      requirement["Enforce SASL/SCRAM and TLS Transport for Kafka Client Connectivity"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0801"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-streaming", label: "OCI Streaming", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_private_endpoint_enforced_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools (Tier-10 • Profile B)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.private_endpoint_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure private_endpoint_settings.subnet_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_vault_cmk_encryption_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Vault Customer-Managed Key (KMS) Encryption on Stream Pools (Tier-10 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_kafka_sasl_tls_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce SASL/SCRAM and TLS Transport for Kafka Client Connectivity (Tier-10 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kafka_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kafka_settings.bootstrap_servers for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_private_endpoint_enforced_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools (Tier-11 • Profile E)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.private_endpoint_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure private_endpoint_settings.subnet_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Streaming"]
      requirement["Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0805"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-streaming", label: "OCI Streaming", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.

: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"

checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_vault_cmk_encryption_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Vault Customer-Managed Key (KMS) Encryption on Stream Pools (Tier-11 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_kafka_sasl_tls_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce SASL/SCRAM and TLS Transport for Kafka Client Connectivity (Tier-11 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kafka_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kafka_settings.bootstrap_servers for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    end

developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_private_endpoint_enforced_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Endpoint Access on OCI Streaming Pools (Tier-12 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.private_endpoint_settings
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure private_endpoint_settings.subnet_id for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted

developer_guide.name: Asynchronous worker and dead-letter recovery
developer_guide.contract: Message ID, schema version, idempotency key, ack deadline and retry limit
dependencies: A producer, message channel and explicit consumer integration
A worker identity, retry policy and dead-letter destination
An idempotent write or side-effect handler
steps: Create the channel, subscription or queue and configure consumer permissions.
Implement idempotency and acknowledge only after successful processing.
Configure retry and dead-letter behavior and a controlled replay procedure.
tests: Send a valid message, a duplicate and a poison message.
Confirm successful side effects, bounded retries and dead-letter delivery.
failures: Message age rising: inspect consumer health, permissions and concurrency.
Duplicate writes: inspect idempotency storage and acknowledgement timing.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_streaming.oci_streaming_streaming_vault_cmk_encryption_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce OCI Vault Customer-Managed Key (KMS) Encryption on Stream Pools (Tier-12 • Profile I)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_streaming_stream_pool"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}

      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end

      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-streaming", label: "OCI Streaming", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]

      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }

      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end
