developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_ocir_private_repositories_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Artifact Registry (OCIR) Repository Private Visibility (Tier-11 • Profile E)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_artifacts_container_repository"
  not r.change.after.is_public
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure is_public for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Registry & DevOps"]
      requirement["Enforce Artifact Registry (OCIR) Repository Private Visibility"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0934"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-devops", label: "OCI Registry & DevOps", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_image_tag_immutability_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Container Image Tag Immutability to Thwart Supply Chain Poisoning (Tier-11 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_artifacts_container_repository"
  not r.change.after.is_immutable
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure is_immutable for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_signed_images_enforced_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Cryptographic Image Signatures with OCI Vault Before OKE Deployment (Tier-11 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.image_policy_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure image_policy_config.is_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_ocir_private_repositories_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Artifact Registry (OCIR) Repository Private Visibility (Tier-12 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_artifacts_container_repository"
  not r.change.after.is_public
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure is_public for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Registry & DevOps"]
      requirement["Enforce Artifact Registry (OCIR) Repository Private Visibility"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0937"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-devops", label: "OCI Registry & DevOps", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_image_tag_immutability_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Container Image Tag Immutability to Thwart Supply Chain Poisoning (Tier-12 • Profile I)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_artifacts_container_repository"
  not r.change.after.is_immutable
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure is_immutable for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_signed_images_enforced_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Cryptographic Image Signatures with OCI Vault Before OKE Deployment (Tier-12 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.image_policy_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure image_policy_config.is_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

# Rule: Enforce Artifact Registry (OCIR) Repository Private Visibility (Tier-13 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_artifacts_container_repository"
  not r.change.after.is_public
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure is_public for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_image_tag_immutability_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Container Image Tag Immutability to Thwart Supply Chain Poisoning (Tier-13 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_artifacts_container_repository"
  not r.change.after.is_immutable
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure is_immutable for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Registry & DevOps"]
      requirement["Enforce Container Image Tag Immutability to Thwart Supply Chain Poisoning"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0941"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-devops", label: "OCI Registry & DevOps", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_signed_images_enforced_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Cryptographic Image Signatures with OCI Vault Before OKE Deployment (Tier-13 • Profile M)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.image_policy_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure image_policy_config.is_policy_enabled for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_ocir_private_repositories_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Artifact Registry (OCIR) Repository Private Visibility (Tier-14 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_artifacts_container_repository"
  not r.change.after.is_public
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure is_public for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_image_tag_immutability_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Container Image Tag Immutability to Thwart Supply Chain Poisoning (Tier-14 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_artifacts_container_repository"
  not r.change.after.is_immutable
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure is_immutable for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_signed_images_enforced_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Cryptographic Image Signatures with OCI Vault Before OKE Deployment (Tier-14 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_containerengine_cluster"
  not r.change.after.image_policy_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure image_policy_config.is_policy_enabled for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify artifact digest, trusted signer identity, and relevant attestations
An image signature establishes provenance only under the configured trust policy. Scan results, deployment admission, and runtime restrictions remain separate controls.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_devops.oci_devops_devops_ocir_private_repositories_t15

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Artifact Registry (OCIR) Repository Private Visibility (Tier-15 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_artifacts_container_repository"
  not r.change.after.is_public
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure is_public for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_dedicated_clusters_encrypted_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Dedicated AI Clusters with Encrypted Inter-Node Communication
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_dedicated_ai_cluster"
  not r.change.after.type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure type for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.

oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_data_science_private_subnet_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Isolate OCI Data Science Notebook Workspaces in Private Subnets
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_datascience_project"
  not r.change.after.display_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure display_name for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Generative AI"]
      requirement["Isolate OCI Data Science Notebook Workspaces in Private Subnets"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0948"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-ai", label: "OCI Generative AI", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_custom_model_vault_encryption_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Keys (KMS) on AI Training Models and Vector Stores
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_model"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_dedicated_clusters_encrypted_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Dedicated AI Clusters with Encrypted Inter-Node Communication (Tier-2 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_dedicated_ai_cluster"
  not r.change.after.type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure type for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB

      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }

    end

      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.

default allow = false

# Rule: Isolate OCI Data Science Notebook Workspaces in Private Subnets (Tier-2 • Profile E)

deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_datascience_project"
  not r.change.after.display_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure display_name for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_custom_model_vault_encryption_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Keys (KMS) on AI Training Models and Vector Stores (Tier-2 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_model"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_dedicated_clusters_encrypted_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Dedicated AI Clusters with Encrypted Inter-Node Communication (Tier-3 • Profile G)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_dedicated_ai_cluster"
  not r.change.after.type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure type for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Generative AI"]
      requirement["Enforce Dedicated AI Clusters with Encrypted Inter-Node Communication"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0953"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-ai", label: "OCI Generative AI", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_datascience_project"
  not r.change.after.display_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure display_name for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_custom_model_vault_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Keys (KMS) on AI Training Models and Vector Stores (Tier-3 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_model"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_dedicated_clusters_encrypted_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Dedicated AI Clusters with Encrypted Inter-Node Communication (Tier-4 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_dedicated_ai_cluster"
  not r.change.after.type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure type for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Generative AI"]
      requirement["Enforce Dedicated AI Clusters with Encrypted Inter-Node Communication"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0956"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-ai", label: "OCI Generative AI", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_custom_model_vault_encryption_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Keys (KMS) on AI Training Models and Vector Stores (Tier-4 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_model"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_dedicated_clusters_encrypted_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Dedicated AI Clusters with Encrypted Inter-Node Communication (Tier-5 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_dedicated_ai_cluster"
  not r.change.after.type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure type for compliance standard CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark v2.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Generative AI"]
      requirement["Enforce Dedicated AI Clusters with Encrypted Inter-Node Communication"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0959"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-ai", label: "OCI Generative AI", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.

failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_custom_model_vault_encryption_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Keys (KMS) on AI Training Models and Vector Stores (Tier-5 • Profile O)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_model"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_dedicated_clusters_encrypted_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Dedicated AI Clusters with Encrypted Inter-Node Communication (Tier-6 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_dedicated_ai_cluster"
  not r.change.after.type
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure type for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Oracle Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for OCI Generative AI"]
      requirement["Enforce Dedicated AI Clusters with Encrypted Inter-Node Communication"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:oci-iam", label: "OCI IAM policy and compartment authorization", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: OCI-BP-0962"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Oracle Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:oci-ai", label: "OCI Generative AI", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:oci-audit", label: "Supported OCI Audit events and Cloud Guard problems", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package oracle.oci_ai.oci_ai_ai_custom_model_vault_encryption_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Keys (KMS) on AI Training Models and Vector Stores (Tier-6 • Profile R)
# Compliance: CIS OCI 2.1.0, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "oci_generative_ai_model"
  not r.change.after.kms_key_id
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure kms_key_id for compliance standard CIS OCI 2.1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in OCI Console / OCI CLI or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application model invocation
developer_guide.contract: Model ID, validated input schema, output schema, timeout and token budget
dependencies: A deployed or available model endpoint and invocation permission
Application validation, rate limits and an explicit data-handling policy
steps: Configure model selection, identity and bounded inference settings.
Validate inputs and minimize sensitive data sent to the model.
Validate output before using it in application decisions or tool calls.
tests: Exercise malformed input, timeout, quota exhaustion and unexpected output.
Verify model output cannot bypass application authorization.
failures: 429: inspect model quota and request concurrency.
Invalid output: enforce schema validation and bounded retry or fallback.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
oci iam user get
: "${COMPARTMENT_OCID:?Set COMPARTMENT_OCID to target compartment}"
oci compute instance list --compartment-id "$COMPARTMENT_OCID" --output table
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.
